mapper.select:
SELECT
, c.name AS category_name FROM t_service s LEFT JOIN t_category c ON c.id = s.category_id WHERE s.id = #{id}

SELECT
, c.name AS category_name FROM t_service s LEFT JOIN t_category c ON c.id = s.category_id WHERE s.status = 1 ORDER BY s.sales DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_service (category_id, name, cover, description, price, duration, status, sales, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{categoryId}, #{name}, #{cover}, #{description}, #{price}, #{duration}, #{status}, 0, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_service WHERE status = 1
